name: Lunchbox
blurb: Lunchbox has no fixed world spawns — it is a Season Scoreboard reward consumable. This guide covers what it does, how to obtain it, and any vendors, containers or events that hand it over.

consumption.note: Consuming Lunchbox applies the effects below.

obtain.note: Lunchbox is a Season Scoreboard reward consumable (datamined editor ID SCORE_Lunchbox_Consumable) and is also a long-standing Atom Shop item. Open it near friends to apply the Party Favor buff (bonus XP that stacks per player nearby). Check the current Season Scoreboard and the Atom Shop for the live source.
